name: Scorpion Gulch
text: Located in South Mountain Park in Phoenix, Arizona, Scorpion Gulch was built as a home and store by William Lunsford. Lunsford's store sold curios, Indigenous-made items, sodas, and candy. It was still in operation in 1966, when Lunsford was 75.

depictions.name: Scorpion gulch
depictions.text: "Underground Troubles" The scorpion gulch is a location in the Mojave Wasteland FNV.
